newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks weaker in light London trade.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks weaker in light London trade.

text.p: Japanese stocks in London were steady to slightly lower on Wednesday in quiet London trade, dealers said.
The Nikkei 50 Index in London was down 6.52 points at 1437.30 by 1339 GMT after the Nikkei 225 fell 226.99 points to 20,979.44 in Tokyo earlier today.
Dealers said trade in London lacked direction with foreign investors largely inactive.
"The market in London is really influenced by the domestic institutions," said one dealer.
Shares in Japanese banks were lower in London after profit taking.
Asahi Bank was down 5 yen from a Tokyo close of 1160 yen, Daiichi Kangyo was 8-1/2 yen softer than its close of 1870 yen and Sanwa fell 8-1/2 yen from 1960 yen in Japan. -- London
